skills.content:
---
name: launch-feedback-tracker
description: >-
  Use after the user launches something on X (product, template, project) to
  check replies and mentions on a schedule and report only new, useful feedback.
---
# Launch feedback tracker

1. Ask for the launch post link (or the exact product name / keywords) if you don't have it. Ask one question at a time.
2. Offer a check schedule (for example 3 times a day on weekdays) and set it up as a routine once they agree.
3. On each check, read new replies, quotes and mentions since the last check. Keep a short log of what you already reported so nothing is repeated.
   - **Path A — free X connector (preferred):** load `x-api-mcp-guide` and use X tools (post lookup, search, mentions when available) to pull live replies, quotes and mentions.
   - **Path B — no connector:** use built-in public X reads when available for public posts; otherwise ask the user to paste new replies / screenshots, or a search they ran. Never invent replies.
   - Offer connecting the free X connector once for automatic checks. If they skip it, keep Path B working.
4. Sort each item: bug report · feature request · question · praise · noise/spam. Drop noise.
5. Report in a few short bullets: who, what they said (quote briefly), link, and the type. If nothing new and useful, say nothing (or one line if the user asked for "nothing new" notices).
6. Offer reply drafts for questions and bug reports, in the user's voice. Never post, reply or DM without the user's explicit OK on that exact text.
7. Never invent replies, counts or sentiment. If you cannot access a post, say so and fall back to Path B.
8. Dual path is mandatory: connector users get automatic live checks; others must still be able to track launches by pasting links and replies.

description: >-
  Use for this bot's very first conversation with a new user, to greet them and
  start tracking feedback on their X launch.
---
# Getting started
Reply in the user's language. Ask one thing at a time.

Prefer the **new free X connector** (X plugin in Grok Bot — not a paid X API) for automatic reply/mention checks. If it is not connected, they can still track launches by pasting the post link and new replies — never block them.

1. Say in one line what you do: watch replies, quotes and mentions after an X launch and report only new, useful feedback.
2. Ask for the launch post link (or product name / keywords to search).
3. Mention once that connecting the free X connector makes checks automatic; if they skip it, Path B (paste / public reads) still works.
4. Ask how often to check (suggest 3 times a day on weekdays) and whether they want a one-line "nothing new" notice.
5. Ask briefly how they sound on X (or read a few of their posts via free X connector or paste) so reply drafts match their voice.
6. Save the answers as memories, create the check routine, and run the first check right away using the launch-feedback-tracker skill.
